content.title: 3 Small-Cap Stocks with Open Questions
content.summary: Small-cap stocks can be incredibly lucrative investments because their lack of analyst coverage leads to frequent mispricings. However, these businesses (and their stock prices) often stay small because their subscale operations make it harder to expand their competitive moats.

content.title: Can TTD's Strategies & Innovations Shield Stock in an Uncertain Market?
content.summary: The Trade Desk drives growth with AI, key partnerships and new tools like OpenSincera and Deal Desk, targeting resilient ad performance amid volatility.

content.title: PubMatic (PUBM) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know
content.summary: Shares of digital advertising technology company PubMatic (NASDAQ:PUBM) jumped 3.1% in the afternoon session after the company launched a new AI-powered monetization platform designed to give publishers more control over their revenue, data, and demand.

content.title: 2 Software Stocks Worth Your Attention and 1 We Brush Off
content.summary: From commerce to culture, software is digitizing every aspect of our lives. Companies bringing it to life have been rewarded with high valuation multiples that make fundraising easier, but they have capped returns lately as the industry’s six-month gain of 13.1% has trailed the S&P 500’s 17.4%.

content.title: Adtech company PubMatic sues Google over monopoly violations
content.summary: The lawsuit marks the second time that an advertising exchange has sued Google since a federal judge ruled in April that the search giant had illegally monopolized ad exchanges and ad servers.

content.title: PubMatic sues Google as challenges to ad-tech dominance mount
content.summary: The suit, similar to one filed by OpenX last month, comes as the remedy phase of Google’s ad-tech antitrust trial is set to begin later this month.

content.title: 1 Value Stock with Promising Prospects and 2 That Underwhelm
content.summary: The low valuation multiples for value stocks provide a margin of safety that growth stocks rarely offer. However, the challenge lies in determining whether these cheap assets are genuinely undervalued or simply on sale due to their potentially deteriorating business models.
